title: DASH PANEL OUTLETS
summary: Cowl plenum water drains (dash panel outlets) at each side of the plenum, behind the front fenders: a molded outlet bonded into the plenum, a second outlet (drain flapper/duct, LH/RH) clamped onto it with a riveted strap, and the plenum panel filler bonded at the top. Everything is bonded (bonds B, K, L) except the strap, which is closed with a rivet.

fastening.note: View A: strap [5] wraps the neck of outlet [2] where it fits over outlet [3]; the strap is closed with rivet [4].
Outlet [2] bonded at bond line 'K' (View A and main view).
Outlet [3] bonded around its base at bond line 'B'.

notes: Water test note (rewritten): a severe water test may push some water in through the dash panel outlets; ignore this, as the test is an abnormal condition. With correct installation and normal water conditions, no water should get in. (Ref. G.M. water separati... - text cut off at the page edge.)
